title: circuit-unfreeze-reconciler-and-regional-fence-hotpatch
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: We observed multiple incidents where regional circuit states became permanently 'stuck' after a transient control-plane partition and leader failover, causing tenants to remain in a soft-deny state until manual intervention. This PR implements a reconciler that detects stale 'frozen' circuit entries and performs a safe unfreeze using quorum-aware checks. It also adds a regional fence to avoid races during simultaneous reconnects. Summary of changes: 1) services/slo-enforcer: add CircuitUnfreezeReconciler that scans circuits with last_transition older than a configurable TTL and attempts idempotent unfreeze with optimistic compare-and-swap; 2) pkg/circuit: introduce CircuitFence token and lease semantics to serialize unfreeze attempts per-region; 3) controlplane/leader: emit a short-lived leader_epoch header to all replicas to make unfreeze decisions quorum-aware; 4) k8s manifests: add a new cronjob to run a low-priority reconciler when leader load is high; 5) tests: unit + integration harness simulating partition and leader churn; 6) telemetry: add circuit_unfreeze_attempts and circuit_unfreeze_outcome metrics for alerting. Testing & rollout: unit tests added. Integration scenario seeded in perf-canary harness. Staged rollout: enabled by feature flag off by default, flipped for a single region for 4 hours, monitored, then global. Monitoring playbook appended. Checklist: [x] implement reconciler logic [x] add fence semantics [x] add leader_epoch header [x] unit tests [x] integration scenario [x] telemetry & alerts [x] rollout plan and playbook. Related: incident SUP-8743 and ENG-1429.

review_comments: Ravi Shah: Please ensure the reconciler respects tenant-level blackout windows. Also can we reduce scan frequency to avoid DB load?
Ava Martinez: Addressed. Reconciler respects tenant blackout via config and uses a distributed rate limiter. Scan frequency default set to 5m and cronjob is low-priority with backoff.
Liam O'Connor: The fencing token looks good, but can we make lease duration tied to leader_epoch to prevent stale leases?
Ava Martinez: Updated fence leases to include leader_epoch and added a check to reject leases from older epochs. Added unit tests for epoch mismatch.
Sofia Nguyen: Integration tests flaked once on CI (timing) — can you add deterministic clocks to the harness?
Ava Martinez: Added fake clock to the integration harness and pinned timings; reran CI and integration passed.
Ravi Shah: Approving — validate alert thresholds after canary and remove feature flag once stable.
Liam O'Connor: Approved with comment to monitor circuit_unfreeze_outcome rate; we should investigate if unfreeze failures >1%.
release_notes: Hotpatch: reconciler to automatically unfreeze stuck circuit state after control-plane partitions. Adds region-scoped fencing and telemetry. Rollout behind feature flag; recommended canary for 4 hours followed by global enable. No API changes.
